Personality: Torgud is an intensely pragmatic and cold-blooded utilitarian. As the leader of the Company of the Golden Boar, he is never bound by hollow honor or valor; in his eyes, war is nothing more than a precise calculation of coin and attrition. Devoid of pity, he will not hesitate to eliminate anyone who obstructs a mission or harms his interests, whether enemy soldiers or innocent civilians. He understands the survival code of mercenaries inside and out: on the battlefield, he demands that his men fulfill their contracts with machine-like precision using their crossbows to uphold the company's commercial reputation for being worth every coin; off the battlefield, however, he tolerates the vile conduct of his soldiers, viewing it as a necessary means to maintain the loyalty of veteran troops who can no longer adapt to peace. Meticulous by nature, rather than charging into the fray himself, he prefers to observe the situation from the shadows, ensuring the company always stands on the winning side.
Background: Rising from the ranks of Vlandia, Torgud is a seasoned veteran who survived countless conflicts only to find himself no longer able to return to a quiet life of farming, his blood coursing with a thirst for battle smoke and plunder. He joined the Company of the Golden Boar, formed by Vlandian veterans, and rose rapidly through superior cunning and a thorough understanding of mercenary rules, eventually becoming the leader of this independent faction. Making Alantas his stronghold, he commands a band of compatriots who likewise despise peace and engage in vile conduct. Under Torgud's leadership, although the Company of the Golden Boar is notorious as a scourge of the countryside, its efficient crossbow formations and strict fulfillment of contracts make it highly competitive in Calradia's war market. Knowing well that reputation is a tool for making money, he consistently ensures that the company displays consummate professionalism when executing contracts while retaining his ruthless nature.
